defaults.t4: Four pieces that work together. Hover a row to see it, or add the whole set and save 10%.

defaults.t2: We work with eight studios, most within a few hours' drive of our warehouse. Hover a maker to read about them.

defaults.t4: Throws every mug on a kick wheel she restored herself. Her satin glazes are mixed in batches of five litres, which is why colours shift slightly between runs.
Spent twenty years making architectural tiles before turning to vases. Every ribbed vase is cut by hand while the clay is still leather-hard.
Develops the glazes for the whole collection and makes the lamp bases. Tests each new colour on forty pieces before it goes on sale.
“Softest linen I've owned, and it really does get better every wash. Arrived in recycled paper, no plastic.”
“The moss glaze is even nicer in person. One arrived chipped and they replaced it the next day without any fuss.”
“Warm light, lovely weight to it. I ordered a second one for the other side of the bed.”
“Bigger than I expected in the best way. You can see the maker's marks, which is exactly why I bought it.”
and a person will reply within a day.

defaults.t2: How much is delivery, and how long does it take?
defaults.t3: Free on orders over $120, otherwise $12 anywhere in Australia. We pack and ship within one to two business days, and most orders arrive three to six days after that.
Yes, within 30 days if it's unused. Start a return from the link in your order email and we'll send a prepaid label. Refunds land within five business days of the parcel reaching us.
Send us a photo within seven days and we'll replace it at no cost. You don't need to send the broken piece back.
Yes, and microwave safe too. Because each glaze is mixed by hand, colours vary a little from piece to piece. That's expected, not a fault.
Cool machine wash, then line dry or tumble dry on low. It's pre-washed, so it won't shrink much, and it gets softer every time you wash it.

defaults.t2: One email when a new batch is ready, a few days before it goes on sale. Small batches sell out, so this is the easiest way to get first pick.
